items.t: Could Booking Holdings (BKNG) Lose Travel Search Ground To New AI Gatekeepers?
items.sum: Booking Holdings (NasdaqGS:BKNG) faces a new competitive threat after OpenAI agreed to acquire travel AI specialist Odessia. The Odessia deal gives OpenAI control of an AI trip-planning engine that sits directly between travelers and booking platforms. items.t: Expedia and Booking shares rise after United Airlines blocks AI booking
items.sum: Investing.com -- Expedia Group Inc and Booking Holdings Inc shares gained Wednesday after United Airlines announced it will block personal artificial-intelligence assistants from accessing its systems to book tickets.

items.t: Expedia, Booking and Airbnb fall as OpenAI reportedly buys AI travel platform
items.sum: Investing.com -- Online travel stocks fell to session lows Tuesday after The Information reported that OpenAI had acquired Odessia, an AI-powered travel planning platform, raising concerns about the potential for increased competition from artificial intelligence in the travel industry.
